name: Counsel
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of divine and wise counsel in guiding the believer’s path, as God promises to instruct and counsel His people personally (Psalms 32:8). The Word of God serves as a lamp to illuminate our decisions and direction (Psalms 119:105), while a wise person actively seeks and grows in understanding to attain sound counsel (Proverbs 1:5). Conversely, rejecting God’s counsel leads to calamity and mockery of one’s fear (Proverbs 1:24-26), highlighting the serious consequences of ignoring divine guidance.
